notes.text: Asked about the hackathon conflict. Candidate repeated the plan: owners, deadline, full run on Thursday. Very quick to act.
Why keep Dana's version? Said it works, and that is what matters for the demo. Did not mention fairness to Dana.
Values question (doing the right thing at a cost): reported a classmate who copied homework. Said: I felt bad, but rules are rules.
If Thursday fails? We cut scope and move on. No word about how people feel afterwards.
Risks of the new review rule: named slower merges and suggested a 24-hour review limit.
